Now the plan tests are meaningful and pass (700 random cases with active requests).

The two remaining t_request failures are my test's fault: the request quota 'g' has capacity 1 (default rq=1) which caps the plan at 1. Let me set rq=9 for those two tests.

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'

check('offer capacity',(out['plan']['resolved'],out['plan']['cost']),(2,3))""",
"""                [offer('o1',capacity=1,cost=1,requests=('r1','r2')),
